items.title: Physicists turn particles in chaotic orbits into liquid computers — but this fluid hardware still trails memristor rivals
items.summary: Each oscillator is a silica sphere of 3μm radius, capped on one side with 80nm of carbon and suspended in a water-lutidine mixture held at 28°C.
items.translatedTitle: 物理学家将混沌轨道上的粒子转化为液态计算机—但这种流体硬件仍然落后于忆阻器的竞争对手

items.title: Kalmar Ottawa electric yard truck gets to work in Canada
items.summary: Kalmar Ottawa has been a leader in diesel-powered yard trucks for decades, but as global logistics fleets move to reduce costs and insulate themselves from volatile diesel prices, the company is making that shift, too – and they’re out to prove their new, battery-electric T2 EV can deliver the same durability and productivity that’s made the original T2 a fixture at ports for years.
items.translatedTitle: 卡尔玛渥太华电动庭院卡车在加拿大上班

items.title: Chinese CXMT DRAM doesn't look like the budget savior many were expecting — new modules enter the market, but prices still track the big three
items.summary: Chinese retail listings indicate that CXMT-based memory modules are priced similarly to those featuring chips from the big three, despite expectations that they must be cheaper.
items.translatedTitle: 中国CXMT DRAM看起来不像许多人期望的预算救星—新模块进入市场，但价格仍然跟踪三巨头

items.title: Another day at the office: Fortescue CEO test drives 150 ton haul truck [video]
items.summary: Industrial mining giants Fortescue have been leading the charge towards electrifying every aspect of their operations – and last week, the company’s CEO took some time to actually get out and test drive some of the company’s newest battery-powered heavy machines.

items.title: Windrose says 10 of its electric semi trucks are coming to Texas’ I-35 corridor
items.summary: The electric semi truck market seems to be heating up in Texas, with Wen Han’s upstart Windrose brand set to deploy 10 fully electric Class 8 trucks on the I-35 freight corridor between Dallas and Laredo en route to Mexico (but there are some caveats).
items.translatedTitle: Windrose表示，其10辆电动半卡车即将进入德克萨斯州的I-35走廊

items.title: E-quipment highlight: Avant Tecno e727 electric wheel loader
items.summary: Increasingly volatile fuel prices are making electric equipment options a need, rather than a want for many fleets, and Avant Tecno is working to meet that need with the new e727 electric wheel loader – the company’s largest offering in North America.
items.translatedTitle: 电子设备亮点： Avant Tecno e727电动轮式装载机
